pageLayout.arrange.rotate.flip-vertical.note: U:grid/page-layout: mirrors the picked pictures and shapes top to bottom.

pageLayout.arrange.rotate.flip-horizonta.note: U:grid/page-layout: mirrors the picked pictures and shapes left to right.

pageLayout.arrange.rotate.more-rotation-.note: U:grid/page-layout: More Rotation Options opens Excel's Format Shape pane on its Size tab, which this sheet does not have; `arrange.rotate {angle}` sets an exact angle. Hidden.

pageLayout.arrange.align.align-left.note: U:grid/page-layout: aligns the picked objects to their common left edge; needs two or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.align-center.note: U:grid/page-layout: aligns the picked objects on their common vertical centre line; needs two or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.align-right.note: U:grid/page-layout: aligns the picked objects to their common right edge; needs two or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.align-top.note: U:grid/page-layout: aligns the picked objects to their common top edge; needs two or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.align-middle.note: U:grid/page-layout: aligns the picked objects on their common horizontal centre line; needs two or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.align-bottom.note: U:grid/page-layout: aligns the picked objects to their common bottom edge; needs two or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.distribute-hori.note: U:grid/page-layout: spaces the picked objects evenly between the outermost two, left to right; needs three or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.distribute-vert.note: U:grid/page-layout: spaces the picked objects evenly between the outermost two, top to bottom; needs three or more objects picked together.

pageLayout.arrange.align.snap-to-grid.note: U:grid/page-layout: Snap to Grid: dragged and sized objects line up with the cell borders (a window setting).

pageLayout.arrange.align.snap-to-shape.note: U:grid/page-layout: Snap to Shape: dragged and sized objects line up with the edges of the other objects (a window setting).

pageLayout.arrange.align.view-gridlines.note: U:grid/page-layout: View Gridlines shows or hides the sheet's gridlines (view.gridlines).

pageLayout.arrange.group.group.note: U:grid/page-layout: groups the picked objects (two or more).

pageLayout.arrange.group.regroup.note: U:grid/page-layout: puts the last group of the picked objects back.

pageLayout.arrange.rotate.rotate-right-9.note: U:grid/page-layout: turns the picked pictures and shapes 90 degrees clockwise.

pageLayout.arrange.rotate.rotate-left-90.note: U:grid/page-layout: turns the picked pictures and shapes 90 degrees anticlockwise.
